limitations: Exact cardinality only; odd prime length and constant-modulus sequences. Bound is shown attained for prime five only; not proven sharp for every larger prime. No numerical stability or approximate-support statement. Historical priority remains provisional.
scientific_integrity: The all-prime argument uses a self-contained ordered-difference uniqueness lemma and a cyclic phase-ratio recurrence. The exact checker is supplementary, not an infinite proof. Earlier characterization of the p-supported equality case is credited to Nicola.
title: A phase-only ambiguity support gap beyond quadratic chirps
